verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gemini CLI can automate PR-related tasks (querying PRs, complex rebases, PR review, GitHub integration via @gemini-cli mentions) but there's no explicit mention of it staging changes, writing commit messages, or creating branches/opening PRs autonomously as a workflow. Community feedback also raises concerns about its agentic reliability and file-handling safety, undercutting confidence in it fully delivering this review-safety workflow.
